I have had trouble with my Roku freezing after streaming Amazon for more than a few hours. I found out how to completely clear the cache. After clearing it, my apps run faster and I doesn't freeze up on me as quickly.

Make sure you are "Home" First click the home button 5 times Then the up button once Next click the rewind button twice Finally the fastforward button twice

It will scroll to "my feed" if done correctly. It will take about 15-30 seconds to clear and restart.

I hope this helps someone else.
